approach.method_basis: The Parent generates fresh molecular graphs, fits a count-fingerprint Gaussian process, and fits a fixed boosted-tree predictor to raw score differences between accepted molecules. The tree expert averages predictions anchored to every accepted molecule. One convex weight, learned from the two experts’ earlier paid prediction errors, mixes that expert with the GP mean. The mixture supplies the selection location while the original correlated GP residual and GP-mean eligibility rule remain active. Feedback updates the accepted archive, survivors and breeding population.
approach.novelty: Fit that same weight to score differences within earlier completed paid batches. Subtracting each batch’s common offset makes the objective sensitive to contrast magnitude rather than batch-wide level error. The supplied brief has no evaluated children of this Parent. Earlier lineage experiments changed reference support, directional symmetry or the predictor itself; this intervention changes only the chronological weight objective. The existing audit motivates a gap-error test and already shows slightly worse ordering, so improved ranking is not predicted.

observed_bottleneck: The weighted code Parent n-b8387b35c526 minimizes historical raw-level error, allowing batch-common offsets to influence a coefficient consumed in within-pool choices. Its complete Search evidence (nodes/n-b8387b35c526/analysis.json and the three original seed summary.json/run.log pairs) confirms 435 strict-prior batches and 4350 paid joins: mixture/raw/GP raw MSE 0.008916241031931662/0.010624093920525894/0.008984261141526123, yet mixture ordering 0.6875801898896587 remains below GP 0.6914036438285861, and GP-exclusive purchases have adverse mixture error. The all15-session read-only contrast audit at policy/scratch/search_policy-665a34ff5204/contrast-audit-summary.json, its fifteen exact audit-seed-N-task.json files, and their original Parent logs/trajectories support this specific test: centered versus level gap MSE is 0.015005469311806734 versus 0.0151554558032042, raw MSE is 0.008746440415798761 versus 0.008916241031931662, and 386/435 weights differ. Pooled ordering instead declines to 0.6866307415960996; equal-session ordering likewise declines from 0.6875329257092765 to 0.6865549905595854. All purchases in that audit are fixed Parent purchases: it establishes no Child ranking repair, alternative adaptive endpoint or useful unpurchased outcome. Parent macro mean 0.565169586022572, population SD 0.007309023086806232, and its +0.01813946483064599 gain over its own code Parent n-ff10f4d5e7f3 remain conditional development evidence; the third seed is adverse. The formal Anchor criterion is not attained. Correct scalar consistency in n-a53bc2587706 and reciprocal inference in n-e37f5776b0bb did not establish predictive benefit. Their refutations are not inherited capabilities.

hypothesis: Change only the strict-prior convex coefficient objective. For each completed prior paid batch b, let g_i be the GP mean, a_i the unchanged all-reference raw-pair location, and y_i the real accepted score, all predictions frozen before that feedback. Define d_i=a_i-g_i and r_i=y_i-g_i. Accumulate A=sum_b sum_i (d_i-mean_b(d))*(r_i-mean_b(r)) and B=sum_b sum_i (d_i-mean_b(d))^2 in chronological completed-batch order, in float64. Before the next announcement freeze w=clip(A/B,0,1), or exactly 0 when B=0, and use mu_contrast=g+w*(a-g) for every announced choice. This minimizes within-batch squared raw-gap errors and ignores batch-common offsets. For a batch of n equal-sized paid rows, all unordered pair numerator/denominator sums equal n times the centered sums; in this issued profile n=10. The 45 pair terms include true-score ties and are dependent transforms, not 45 independent labels. No initial label, same-batch feedback, cross-batch comparison, decay, ridge, intercept, interpolation parameter, new expert or acquisition change enters this intervention. Preserve the original raw-level coefficient as a passive same-state comparator.

finding_summary.headline: Contrast weights changed purchases; the full predictive test is unresolved after allocation expiry
finding_summary.insights: The borrowed score-difference objective operated as intended, and its effect reached real feedback, survivors and later breeding. This rules out a merely cosmetic weight change or loss of the original GP sampling law. It does not establish the promised predictive benefit: the completed-session evidence is slightly adverse, and the purchases that changed most expose a larger weakness. On the 290 molecules excluded by the passive level rule, active raw MSE was 0.0178181 versus 0.0140998 for that rule, even though 43 beat a generating parent, 19 improved an incumbent and 171 were later bred. Predictive error, downstream use and endpoint gains therefore remain separate observations. The adaptation tests one historical convex coefficient on fixed experts; it does not test a full kernel RankRLS learner or settle the broader stacking approach. A model that predicts current proposal-specific errors, rather than relying only on one historical coefficient, is the kind of change that could address this observed calibration limitation; this experiment has not tested it. Molecular evidence also shows an uneven search neighborhood: on equal complete seeds there were 725 generic scaffolds versus 799 for the Parent, and the leading decoration-hopping subset concentrated in one generic scaffold versus seven. More large-molecule and tiny-fragment purchases coexisted with that concentration, while all observed purchases omitted explicit configurations and formal charges. A proposal operator that can change cores and linkers while preserving molecular scale and functional-group context could address that separate expressivity gap. These chemistry associations do not explain the endpoint gain causally. Allocation expiry leaves the registered full-panel question open; it neither refutes the mechanism through nonexecution nor turns the favorable endpoint subset into proof of its predictive premise.
finding_summary.results: The mechanism ran: all 361 observed batches reconstructed correctly, 295 weights differed from the original level-error rule, and 290 accepted molecules fell outside its same-state passive selections. The preregistered predictive test is incomplete: allocation expiry left twelve complete task sessions, one 130-purchase prefix and two absent sessions, providing 16,245 of 19,575 required pairs. On the twelve complete sessions, gap MSE was slightly worse, 0.0159764331 versus 0.0159678870. The ten sessions from fully completed seeds alone were slightly better, 0.0179613935 versus 0.0179676283; the interrupted DRD2 prefix was worse, 0.0558533199 versus 0.0539689253. These differing subsets cannot decide the fifteen-session falsifier. Across all 3,610 observed purchases, raw MSE also worsened, from 0.0107438311 to 0.0110120523, and pooled ordering accuracy fell from 0.687918 to 0.686093; improved ordering was not predicted. The two complete replicas had mean endpoint 0.572379193 versus their matched Parent mean 0.560289151, an issued paired increase of 0.0120900423 with six favorable and four adverse task cells. The full three-seed endpoint effect remains unavailable.

molecular.headline: Ring-rich aromatic molecules mix conventional amide/amine cores with N/O/S–halogen bonds, size extremes and unspecified stereochemistry.
molecular.overall_character: All thirteen issued Child Search trajectories and all fifteen published code-Parent trajectories were read. Child n-e43e4a767e2c supplies 3,740 accepted rows: 130 supplied initials and 3,610 optimizer purchases. Twelve trajectories contain 300 rows. The terminal cancelled seed 1 supplies complete 300-row trajectories for zaleplon_mpo and deco_hop, only 140 rows for drd2_docking (130 optimizer purchases), and no trajectories for median_2 or sitagliptin_mpo. Its summary.json is absent; execution.json records retryable/exit 143 and run.log records allocation time-limit cancellation of step 5238136.81. These are terminal missing observations, not pending work or imputed failures of unseen molecules. Every task has some actual molecules, so all five are described, with seed-1 gaps kept explicit. The frozen comparison has child_complete=false and paired_complete=false; only seeds 0/2 are complete comparable replicas. Parent n-b8387b35c526 has all fifteen trajectories and 4,350 optimizer purchases. Equal-denominator chemistry comparisons below use only seeds 0/2: 2,900 purchases and 1,450 late purchases per node. The full observed Child has 1,740 late purchases; late means optimizer ordinals 146..290, not the final half of an observed partial prefix. These are accepted scored purchases, not every unpurchased generator proposal. All descriptor aggregates exclude initials. Output includes indole-like aromatic amides and ketene-bearing condensed heterocycles, linked heteroaromatic/imide assemblies, aryl-bearing saturated amines, large cyclic bis-amides, and fluorinated carbonyl N-heterocycles. Digest ring-closure presence rates are 0.9746–0.9966 and aromatic-token presence rates 0.9648–0.9931; these are SMILES-text molecule-presence rates, not ring counts or aromatic-atom fractions. The recognizable motifs support moderate resemblance to medicinal molecules, but their unusual bonds, ring junctions and size tails make synthetic plausibility questionable. No stability, synthesis, ADME, biological activity or chemical utility is measured. Across all 3,610 observed Child purchases, heavy-atom median/range are 30 and 1–117; 3,542 contain perceived aromatic atoms, and 51 have an empty acyclic Murcko scaffold. Size-tail counts at <=5, <=6, >=50 and >50 atoms are 50,50,316,310. The equal complete-seed comparison is Child 43,43,276,271 versus Parent 36,38,204,192; median sizes are 30 versus 31. Thus the slightly smaller median coexists with more very large molecules and more tiny fragments. Typed/generic Murcko scaffold counts including the empty scaffold are 1,417/869 over all observed Child rows; equal complete-seed counts are 1,185/725 versus Parent 1,330/799. Topology variation exists, but local leading neighborhoods can remain highly concentrated. Preserving the Parent descriptor definition, radius-2 chirality-aware 2,048-count Morgan dot-product Tanimoto is calculated only within a task/seed cell or an actual ten-purchase batch. Equal complete-seed within-cell means are Child 0.626834 versus Parent 0.623772, rising to 0.645267 versus 0.639820 after excluding <=6-heavy-atom fragments. Within-batch means are 0.713194 versus 0.708613, or 0.733897 versus 0.726901 after that exclusion. These are pair-count-weighted descriptions, with no cross-session pairs or diversity reward. Across all observed Child purchases, N–halogen, O–halogen and S–halogen graph flags occur in 898,376 and 118 molecules; O–O single bonds occur in 128. On the equal complete-seed denominator these counts are 659,344,117,101 versus Parent 327,309,56,46. Carbon-centred two-double-bond environments occur in 206 observed Child molecules, with 34 having the central carbon and both double bonds in rings;90 separate sulfur-centred cases are not interpreted as allenes. A perceived <=4-atom cycle whose atoms are all aromatic occurs in 211 molecules; this does not establish that every bond or that small cycle is aromatic. There are 108 molecules with a perceived ring of at least nine atoms. All 3,610 Child purchases lack nonzero formal charges, assigned tetrahedral configurations and specified double-bond geometry. RDKit finds 4,055 unassigned tetrahedral centres in 1,946 molecules; neutral depiction does not determine solution protonation. Per-task top/bottom subsets use recorded scores and floor(n/10), with seed/evaluation tie breaking:87,87,71,58,58 rows in fixed task order. The equal complete-seed comparison uses 58 per task; complete-cell subsets use 29 and the partial cell uses 13. Subsets can concentrate in a single seed and are not independent trials. All cell records, initial/optimizer/late/final-ten summaries, both size conventions, scaffolds and fragment-excluded similarities are retained. No molecular association assigns mechanism activation, component contribution or a causal explanation of score movement. method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
